map: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D GAME MAP, authentic 16-bit SNES Final Fantasy VI town tileset pixel-art, deliberately simple 16x16 tile logic, chunky square pixels, limited muted palette. A quiet dark city street at NIGHT. Deep desaturated navy and charcoal buildings, muted gray-brown dry matte stone street, only two tiny weak amber streetlamps. Darkness dominates. No wet surfaces, reflections, glossy highlights, neon, bloom, atmospheric lighting gradients, monochrome, brush painting or photorealism. Small plain closed storefronts, flat roofs, sparse unlit windows, very restrained masonry clusters. Orthographic JRPG overhead view with building front walls visible, no horizon/vanishing point. Landscape 10:7. Precise map layout: top 4/14 buildings; next1/14 sidewalk; middle4/14 empty broad dry street; next1/14 sidewalk; bottom4/14 building roofs. TWO simple small streetlamp posts ONLY on upper sidewalk centered at 12.5% and87.5% width, base at 32% image height, dim amber bulb at25.5% height. Other windows almost all DARK. Lamp light tiny and localized, no large glowing pools, street remains dull. No characters, objects on road, text, UI, border or grid. Match old cartridge game background pixel fidelity; flat matte colors, 3-tone shading, no excessive texture. Render crisp pixel clusters as if an original 320x224 screen enlarged with nearest-neighbor.
yeonwoo: Use case: stylized-concept. GAME SPRITE SHEET on actual transparent alpha. Exactly 2 columns x4 rows, 8 small separate sprites. Authentic 1994 SNES 16-BIT FINAL FANTASY VI / DRAGON QUEST V overworld character sprite style. NOT modern chibi illustration. Each character equivalent to only16 pixels wide x24 pixels tall, enlarged nearest-neighbor with clearly countable chunky square pixels. Tiny face with TWO SINGLE BLACK PIXEL eyes, NO anime eyes, NO eye highlights. Head only 9 pixels tall, body and legs15 pixels, classic compact RPG proportions, not huge bobblehead. 12-color palette, black outline, 2-3 tones per material. Kim Yeonwoo: long straight black hair and bangs trailing down back, black martial-arts outfit with restrained blue lapels, gray belt, black trousers/boots. NO modern smooth art, no shadows, no glow. Rows in order: down front, left profile, right profile, up back. Columns: neutral standing; one simple walking step. Exactly same size head and body between frames. Eight sprites centered in equal-size cells, feet on same baseline per row. Large TRANSPARENT gutters and outer margins. No grid, labels, floor, extra poses. Deliberately modest plain utilitarian game sprites. Prioritize faithful SNES sprites over cuteness.
